messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Rule today (2024): 4.1 Sum insured rebates/discounts offered, if any 4.2 Rebates/charges for different modes offered: 4.3 Premium rebates/discounts 4.4 Staff rebates 4.5 Any other discounts offered 4.9 Pricing Assumptions and Methodology... (no maximum cap specified)
Replaced rule (2020): 5.6 Maximum cap on all Discounts for all variables taken together 5.8 Maximum Cap on all Loading for all variables taken together
Existing questions: ['Is there a limit on the total discount I can receive on my health insurance premium?', 'Does the insurer have a maximum cap on any loadings applied to my policy?']
Write 2 NEW, differently worded questions (e.g. a concrete scenario with a policyholder) whose correct answer today is the 2024 rule. JSON: {"questions": [str, str]}

content: {"questions":["I’m buying a family health plan and heard there might be a discount limit – can I get unlimited rebates on the sum insured and premium under the current rules?","My employer wants to know if the insurer can apply a cap on the total loading for my policy’s various riders, or is there any overall limit now?"]}
